landing.heroSubtitle: Subscribe to mechanics, doctors, dentists and more with auditable blockchain guarantees. No hidden clauses or broken promises: transparent commitments enforced by code.
landing.disenadoPara: Designed for Customers and Service Providers
landing.eligePerfil: Choose your profile when connecting your wallet and access your specialized dashboard.
landing.clientesDesc: Hire guaranteed services for your vehicle, health or business. Manage your monthly payments, view your coverage and file claims if the service doesn't meet its promises.
landing.proveedoresDesc: Are you a doctor, mechanic, dentist or professional? Offer recurring guarantee plans to your customers to retain them, ensure monthly income and manage claims with full transparency.
landing.explorarGarantiasDesc: Explore and hire guarantees backed by Sepolia offered by verified professionals.
landing.estandarAbierto: An open standard that protects customers and backs the best professionals.
landing.feature1Desc: Each guarantee contract is recorded on the Sepolia network immutably and transparently.
landing.feature2Desc: Secure periodic memberships. No surprise charges and cancellation with a single click.
landing.feature3Desc: Funds and coverage are managed through Unlock Protocol smart contracts.
landing.feature4Desc: File guarantee claims with evidence and receive fair and verifiable resolutions.
landing.feature5Desc: Your guarantee takes effect immediately upon signing with your Web3 wallet.
landing.feature6Desc: Open platform for doctors, clinics, mechanics, plumers and consultants.
